name: cards
title: Kybernesis Cards
description: Cards under a reply in KYBER Studio and the phone: key numbers, a chart, a table, a checklist, a short profile of a person or company, or a link, through a show tool the model calls once it has the data, and short forms through ask_form. Text channels get each card's plain text, so a reply still reads without it.

files.content:
# Cards

When the answer is structured data, such as a few key numbers, a trend, rows, progress or a short profile of a person or company, show it with `show` once you have the data, and say in a sentence or two what matters about it. Don't repeat the card's contents in the reply.

KYBER Studio, the phone app and Buzz draw cards (in Buzz, with the Kybernesis cards plugin; without it, people read the card's own text). Use `show` there too and keep the reply short. On Slack and iMessage, which never draw cards, write the answer in words.
